extDescription.message: Detects phishing links right in your browser. Local analysis: your URLs never leave your device.

actionTitle.message: PhishGuard: click to check this page

badgeTitleSafe.message: PhishGuard: no sign of phishing on $HOST$

explain_safe.message: PhishGuard found no sign of phishing in this address.

explain_suspicious.message: This address shows signs often seen in phishing.

explain_phishing.message: This address strongly resembles those of phishing sites.

explain_allowlist.message: This site is on your list of trusted sites: PhishGuard does not check it.

explain_lookalike.message: The address mixes alphabets to imitate a well-known name. This signal applies even to trusted sites.

explain_url_too_long.message: Abnormally long address: PhishGuard does not check all of it, be careful.

advice_url_safe.message: No worrying signs. Stay alert if the page asks for a password or a payment.

advice_url_suspicious.message: Be careful: do not type anything on this page. If in doubt, open the official site by typing its address yourself.

advice_url_phishing.message: Do not enter any password or bank details. Open the site by typing its address yourself.

advice_email_safe.message: No worrying signs. Stay alert if the email asks for a password, a code or a payment.

advice_email_suspicious.message: Be careful: do not open links or attachments until you have checked the sender another way.

advice_email_phishing.message: Do not open any link or attachment and do not reply. Contact the organisation through its official details.

reason_lookalike_host.message: The address imitates Latin letters with another alphabet.

reason_host_is_ip.message: The address is an IP number, not a site name.

reason_brand_impersonation.message: A well-known brand name appears outside its official site.

reason_has_userinfo.message: The address contains "@", which can hide the real site.

reason_is_shortener.message: Shortened link: its real destination is hidden.

reason_text_domain_mismatch.message: The link shown does not lead where it claims to.

reason_non_web_link.message: A link runs code instead of opening a page.

reason_display_name_spoof.message: The display name imitates an address other than the sender's real one.

reason_display_name_domain.message: The display name mentions a different domain from the sender's address.

reason_sender_lookalike.message: The sender's address imitates Latin letters with another alphabet.

popupOnlineFailed.message: Online check unavailable: the local verdict applies.

popupOnlineStrictest.message: The verdict shown is the more cautious of the two checks.

popupTrustConfirmBody.message: PhishGuard will no longer warn about this domain or its subdomains. You can undo this in the settings.

popupTrustWarning_suspicious.message: This site shows suspicious signs. Only trust it if you know it.

popupTrustWarning_phishing.message: Warning: PhishGuard thinks this site imitates a well-known service. Only trust it if you are certain.

popupTrusted.message: $DOMAIN$ is now one of your trusted sites.

popupUntrusted.message: $DOMAIN$ is no longer one of your trusted sites.

popupLinkReanalyze.message: This domain is no longer trusted. Check the link again (right-click) to get its verdict.

popupReportDisabled.message: Sending reports is turned off. Turn it on in the settings: only the domain name would be sent, never the full address.

popupReportPrivacy.message: Only the domain $DOMAIN$, the verdict received and your answer will be sent.

popupReportSent.message: Thank you! Only the domain $DOMAIN$ was sent to $SERVER$.

popupReportNotReportable.message: This site cannot be reported: only a domain name can be, not an IP address.

popupReportFailed.message: The report could not be sent. Try again later.

errorNotAnalyzable.message: This page is not a website (http or https): nothing to check.

errorModelUnavailable.message: The detection model is unavailable. Reinstall the extension.

errorInvalidDomain.message: This is not a valid site address.

errorAllowlistFull.message: Your list of trusted sites is full (1,000 sites).

gmailTitleSuspicious_one.message: PhishGuard: $COUNT$ suspicious link in this message

gmailTitleSuspicious_other.message: PhishGuard: $COUNT$ suspicious links in this message

gmailTitlePhishing_one.message: PhishGuard: this message looks like phishing ($COUNT$ dangerous link)

gmailTitlePhishing_other.message: PhishGuard: this message looks like phishing ($COUNT$ dubious links)

gmailTitleSenderSuspicious.message: PhishGuard: the sender of this message is suspicious

gmailTitleSenderPhishing.message: PhishGuard: the sender of this message imitates another address

gmailTruncated.message: This message contains too many links: some were not checked.

optionsIntro.message: By default, PhishGuard checks everything on your device and sends nothing. Each setting says which data leaves, and where to.

optGmailHelp.message: The links and sender of the message you open are checked on your device. Other messages are never read; nothing is stored or sent. Applies to Gmail tabs opened or reloaded afterwards.

optAuto.message: Automatically check every page I visit

optAutoHelp.message: Your browser will ask you to allow PhishGuard to "read your browsing history": that is what gives it the address of each page. The check stays on your device; no address is sent or kept.

optOnlineIntro.message: Off by default. They use a PhishGuard server of your choice: your own or a trusted service's.

optServerHelp.message: Example: https://phishguard.example.org. https required (http only for localhost or 127.0.0.1).

optApiKeyHelp.message: Sent only to this server. It is stored on this device without encryption: do not use a shared key.

optEnrichmentHelp.message: When you click the PhishGuard icon, the page's full address (without what follows "#") is sent to $SERVER$, which may pass it on to analysis services (VirusTotal, urlscan, Google Safe Browsing…). Never for the automatic check or for Gmail. The server can strengthen a warning, never remove one.

optFeedbackHelp.message: When you report a mistake, only the domain name, the verdict received and your answer are sent to $SERVER$. Never the full address. Reports are reviewed by a person; they never change the model automatically.

optAllowlistHelp.message: Stored on this device only. A trusted site is no longer flagged, unless its address imitates letters from another alphabet.

optAllowlistInvalid.message: This is not a valid site address.

optNever1.message: Keep a history of the pages you visit.

optNever2.message: Assign you an identifier, or track your activity.

optNever3.message: Read Gmail messages other than the one you open.

optNever4.message: Download or run code from the Internet.

optAutoOff.message: Automatic check turned off; the permission was given back.

optPermissionDenied.message: Permission refused: the setting stays off.

optServerInvalid.message: Address refused: https required (http only for localhost or 127.0.0.1), without credentials, parameters or "#".

optApiKeyInvalid.message: Key refused: it starts with "pg_", followed by 43 characters.

optServerSavedOff.message: Server saved. Turn on the online check or reports to use it.

optServerCleared.message: Server removed: nothing can be sent anymore.
